text: A report on Toktogul export revenue (20 November) referred to the Chancellery of the Irad Assembly of Clans. The body is the Iradi Freedom Society, and the Chancellery is its Chancellery.
headline: Toktogul at 83.2% and falling as Uch-Kurgan refit nears its end

text: Kyrgyz pay up 29.4% to about 5,330 Iradi som; ISEZ's last average was 3,250
A report on Bishkek's 327 km border fence (2 November) said the Qara-Chik line is held at nine crossing points. There are ten, with four internal control posts behind them.
headline: Bishkek's 327 km fence is done; Irad's Kyrgyz frontier has no fence and no agreement

text: A report on the Turkic States secretariat (4 November) called the IAC the Irad Autonomous Confederation. It is the Iradi Freedom Society (Iradin Azatlık Cemiyeti).
headline: Uzbek diplomat to lead Turkic States secretariat; Irad has no seat, though all three claimants do

text: A report on Bishkek's 327 km border fence (2 November) gave the length of the Qara-Chik line as about 1,750 km. It is about 1,930 km.
headline: Bishkek's 327 km fence is done; Irad's Kyrgyz frontier has no fence and no agreement

text: Cameras record two snow leopards in upper Besh-Tash; no herder compensation published
